in_hebrew.name: Gaeta
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gaeta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Gaeta is a Latin name derived from the word ‘gatius’. It originally means ‘watchman’ or ‘guardian’. In ancient Rome, a gatius was a protector or defender, often of a city or temple. In Christian tradition, Gaeta is a strong and faithful name, representing protection and watchfulness over one's community or loved ones.
